flags: WEBSITE WRONG: stored riverviewrvparkandmarina.com (both URLs) is Riverview RV Park and Marina, 1270 Vermilion Rd, Vermilion OH, phone (440) 597-8281, on the Vermilion River about 150 km north. Correct operator site is https://riverviewkampground.com/ (the one Google lists; a landing page and contact form only). Phone 740-624-4175 is right: Google lists it for 10425 Old River Rd, McConnelsville. Pin is OK on the park.

INCLUSION EVIDENCE WRONG: the stored evidence ('accepts daily/transient RV bookings (inland sites) plus seasonal riverfront/marina sites; open May-Oct') was read off the Vermilion park. For this park the operator text on Visit Zanesville says 'overnight to seasonal full hook-up', so overnight stays are offered. Needs rewriting.

GATE FACTS: posted rate none on the operator's site. Visit Zanesville (operator text, undated): 'Price range: $30 full hook-up / Seasonal from $1350'. RV Life reviewers: $33 and $45 (weekly discount) in 2022, $30 in 2020. Google shows $175 under its price widget, which is probably the cabin, so don't read it as an RV rate. RV Life tier $$. Good Sam: nothing stated. Gateway: none within 40 km (Columbus 96 km). No engine. Presence: working site (no phone printed on it), Google 4.3 from 26 reviews, phone: passes, narrowly on the review count.

LONG-STAY TEST 2 is the question if this is judged long-stay: the operator calls it an 'overnight to seasonal ... camping and boating community', and no share of seasonals is stated anywhere. The only rate with the operator's wording is the undated $30, and no operator page posts a rate. RV Life reviewers from 2020-2022 stayed as ordinary overnight/weekly guests, so I read it as an ordinary park, but that's a judgement for AWH.

WATERFRONT: stored riverview left as is. The removed 'riverfront sites are seasonal-only' claim was the other park's, so it's no argument either way. A reviewer: 'right across the street from the river.' Imagery: rig rows between Old River Rd and the woods, about 40-100 m from the river, with the road and a thin tree line between (estimates). No site map online, so no re-audit call from me.
